description.value: Combine vaults and corporate strongrooms have started attributing your work to rumors instead of a person. Once per day, after successfully Picking a Lock or Disabling a Device on a secured container, you can conceal all evidence of tampering, requiring a successful Perception check against your Thievery DC to notice the container was ever opened.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule-element key conceals evidence of a successful Pick a Lock/Disable a Device from later detection.
